headline: US, Russia and Ukraine hold trilateral talks aimed at ending war – Europe live

members.title: US officials seek ‘final end’ to Russia-Ukraine war as Abu Dhabi talks begin
members.lead: First substantive peace talks since February to include US proposal for ‘long-term security architecture’ between Moscow and Europe US officials said they would seek a “final end” to the war between Russia and Ukraine, beginning with trilateral talks in Abu Dhabi on Tuesday in the first substantive negotiations between the two countries since February. The talks are also the first since the US launched joint strikes with Israel against Iran, and they follow bruising midterm elections that have weakened Donald Trump at home. Continue reading...

members.title: US, Russia and Ukraine hold trilateral talks aimed at ending war – Europe live
members.lead: The US special envoy Steve Witkoff, who is leading the American delegation alongside Jared Kushner - Donald Trump’s son-in-law – has just posted on X with details of their meeting with European and Ukrainian officials ahead of the trilateral talks between the US, Ukraine and Russia. Witkoff said the meeting helped to coordinate their efforts to end the war and “establish the conditions for a durable peace”, including support for “robust security guarantees” for Kyiv. He said officials from Europe, the US and Ukraine shared the same objectives and all held a commitment to “Euro-Atlantic security”. He wrote: Participants emphasized that any future arrangements must respect sovereignty, territorial integrity, independent decision-making, and provide credible security guarantees for Ukraine. The shared objective is to develop a practical and mutually reinforcing security framework that strengthens Ukraine’s long-term security and builds the confidence necessary to reach a negotiated settle
